manifestPurpose: Pinned native OCCT static slices for FloeCADKit. The .a files are too large for ordinary Git block push, so they are NOT committed as Git blobs: bootstrap.py fetches the exact, content-addressed Git-LFS base objects from the pinned upstream repository and verifies size and SHA-256. Each artifact also declares a required source derivation: the reviewed Standard_Type lifetime backport is reconstructed locally from that exact base archive plus the tracked recipe/source/patch. A valid derivation receipt is required; the pinned upstream base alone is reported UNPREPARED because it contains the known-crashing registry lifetime. Header files remain Git-tracked and are not managed here.
lastDerivationIntegrated: 2026-11-01 (Root actual two-slice artifacts qualified; App121 relink identity recorded; App125 normal STEP/exit gate pending)

openshape3d.note: The batch API returns a short-lived, content-addressed pre-signed download URL per object oid. Only the endpoint and oid are durable pins; the pre-signed URL is fetched at run time and must never be hard-coded.

trackedButNotBootstrapped.headers: Vendor/OCCT.xcframework/ios-arm64/Headers/** (7,963 flat OCCT 7.8.1 headers) and the ios-arm64-simulator/Headers symlink remain Git-tracked; they are platform-independent and are not downloaded by bootstrap.py.
trackedButNotBootstrapped.excludedSlice: The upstream ios-arm64-maccatalyst slice is intentionally not vendored; see UPSTREAM.md.
trackedButNotBootstrapped.derivationReceipts: Vendor/OCCT.xcframework/**/*.derivation.json are generated provenance records for locally reconstructed slices; they are not committed. The tracked recipe/source/patch under relink/derivations/ and the base pins above are the reviewable integrity inputs.

relink.status: Pinned relink inputs are available (OCCT source, upstream build program, toolchain). Floe does NOT claim a full 47-toolkit byte-identical rebuild. The shipped base bytes remain the pinned upstream OpenShape3D Git-LFS objects; each installed OCCT slice additionally carries one surgical source derivation (Standard_Type lifetime) reconstructed from that base with the tracked recipe, source, patch and a declared Apple toolchain. A bare pinned base is not accepted as prepared: bootstrap reports it UNPREPARED. bootstrap --check validates the derivation receipt and archive invariants read-only; bootstrap --release-check additionally requires the qualified Xcode/SDK and the tracked expectedResult.

occt.name: Open CASCADE Technology
occt.commitResolution: Resolved 2026-10-10: refs/tags/V7_8_1 is a lightweight tag, so git ls-remote and the GitHub ref API both report the commit bd2a789f15235755ce4d1a3b07379a2e062fdc2e directly (message 'Update version to 7.8.1').

floeSourceChanges.description: Keep the Standard_Type type-registry allocation alive for the OCCT image/process lifetime so static Standard_Type handles in other translation units can be destroyed after the function-local registry without a use-after-destruction hash-table read. Public ABI and every other archive member are unchanged.

toolchain.name: leetal ios-cmake ios.toolchain.cmake
toolchain.note: Upstream OpenShape3D does not pin the toolchain revision; Floe pins the concrete tag/commit and file hash here so the relink route is reproducible. The build script documents CMake >= 3.16 and was tested by upstream with CMake 4.4.
